theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  classical
  let f : ℕ → (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  have h_finite : Set.Finite (Set.range f) := by
    have : Set.range f ⊆ Set.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T) := by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨⟨⟨hB n, hB (n + 1)⟩, hB (n + 2)⟩, hB (n + 3)⟩⟩
    exact Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_mem_finset (Finset.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T))) this
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h_eq⟩ : ∃ i j, i < j ∧ f i = f j := by
    by_contra! h
    have : Function.Injective f := by
      intro i j h_eq
      by_cases h_ij : i = j
      · exact h_ij
      · cases lt_or_gt_of_ne h_ij with
        | inl h_ij => exact h i j h_ij h_eq
        | inr h_ij => exact h j i h_ij (by simp [h_eq])
    exact Set.not_infinite.mpr h_finite (Set.infinite_range_of_injective this)
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, f] at h_eq
  have h_periodic : ∀ m, u (i + m) = u (j + m) := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h m ih =>
      match m with
      | 0 => exact h_eq.1
      | 1 => exact h_eq.2.1
      | 2 => exact h_eq.2.2.1
      | 3 => exact h_eq.2.2.2
      | m + 4 =>
        have h_i := hu (i + m + 4) (by omega)
        have h_j := hu (j + m + 4) (by omega)
        simp only [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h_i h_j ⊢
        have : (u (i + m) : ℝ) = (u (j + m) : ℝ) := by norm_cast; exact ih m (by omega)
        have : (u (i + m + 1) : ℝ) = (u (j + m + 1) : ℝ) := by norm_cast; exact ih (m + 1) (by omega)
        have : (u (i + m + 2) : ℝ) = (u (j + m + 2) : ℝ) := by norm_cast; exact ih (m + 2) (by omega)
        have : (u (i + m + 3) : ℝ) = (u (j + m + 3) : ℝ) := by norm_cast; exact ih (m + 3) (by omega)
        simp_all only [add_assoc, add_sub_cancel]
        norm_cast
  use i, j - i
  constructor
  · omega
  · intro n hn
    have := h_periodic (n - i)
    simp [add_sub_cancel_of_le hn] at this ⊢
    exact this
